title: Gandhi and the Jew
description: A friendship that changed the world. Before Gandhi became Gandhi, an unlikely bond with a Jewish architect helped him build the philosophy of nonviolence— until history's most unresolvable conflict tested everything they'd built together.
location: Colony Theatre, 1040 Lincoln Rd, Miami Beach
